Software security activities




Red Hat designs software to meet appropriate security and risk mitigation requirements.  Following secure development activities throughout the software development life cycle enables security to be built into the design, architecture, and code of the product. Adherence to SDLC enables security to be built into the design and architecture of a software product. Red Hat rigorously tests the security of software
